rows.description: Accessible label for the bare fallback pair's end-date input. Read only when `children` is unset.

rows.name: parts
rows.description: Per-part styling for the bare fallback pair's internally composed inputs.

parts.name: RangeCalendar.Cell
parts.description: Renders one calendar day for RangeCalendar, building on Calendar.Cell.

resizable.name: Resizable
resizable.definition:
A split-pane layout arranging Resizable.Panel and
Resizable.Handle parts along a shared axis, each panel taking up
its own declared share of the group's main axis and each handle between
two panels reserving a fixed track across the cross axis. Every part
mirrors the root's orientation onto itself through component context, so a
panel's own minimum and maximum share and a handle's cursor and track both
switch axis together without a consumer repeating the orientation on each
one.
resizable.summary: A split-pane layout arranging Resizable.Panel and Resizable.Handle parts along a shared axis, each panel taking up its own declared share of the group's main axis and each handle between two panels reserving a fixed track across the cross axis.
resizable.description:
Renders the root host: a `<div>` laying Resizable.Panel and
Resizable.Handle children out in a row, or a column when
`orientation` is `"vertical"`, sharing the resolved axis through context; set `aria-disabled="true"` to dim the whole group.
examples:
<Resizable aria-label={t("layout.panes")}>
	<Resizable.Panel id="sidebar" defaultSize={30} minSize={15}>
		{t("layout.sidebar")}
	</Resizable.Panel>
	<Resizable.Handle aria-label={t("layout.resizeSidebar")} aria-controls="sidebar main" />
	<Resizable.Panel id="main" defaultSize={70}>
		{t("layout.main")}
	</Resizable.Panel>
</Resizable>

rows.name: orientation
rows.description: Layout axis. Defaults to DEFAULT_ORIENTATION.

parts.name: Resizable.Panel
parts.description: Renders a single pane: a `<div>` that grows and shrinks to fill its share of the group's main axis, clipping overflow with scrolling.

rows.name: defaultSize
rows.description: Starting share of the group's main axis, as a percentage (e.g. `30` for 30%). Panels left without one split whatever share remains evenly among themselves.

rows.name: minSize
rows.description: Smallest share of the group's main axis this panel will shrink to, as a percentage. Left unset, the panel can shrink down to nothing.

rows.name: maxSize
rows.description: Largest share of the group's main axis this panel will grow to, as a percentage. Left unset, the panel can grow up to the group's entire main axis.

parts.name: Resizable.Handle
parts.description: Renders a draggable divider between two adjacent panels: a `role="separator"` `<div>` reachable in Tab order, its bar darkening on hover and ready for `&[data-resizing]` to color it during a drag.

types.name: Orientation
types.description: Axis the panels lay out along: a row of panels side by side, or a column of panels stacked one above another.

scroll-area.name: ScrollArea
scroll-area.definition:
A scrollable region wrapping long or overflowing content — a chat log, a
table, a tall list — so it scrolls its own axis inside a bordered panel
instead of pushing the surrounding page. ScrollArea.Viewport is the
element that actually scrolls; the root only supplies the panel's border
and rounding.
scroll-area.summary: A scrollable region wrapping long or overflowing content — a chat log, a table, a tall list — so it scrolls its own axis inside a bordered panel instead of pushing the surrounding page.
scroll-area.description:
Renders the scroll area's outer panel: a relatively positioned, rounded,
bordered `<div>` that frames whatever ScrollArea.Viewport scrolls
inside it, staying a fixed border around the scrolling content.

parts.name: ScrollArea.Viewport
parts.description: Renders the scroll area's scrolling surface: a `<div>` filling its parent panel, clipping and scrolling along the axis named by `data-orientation` with a thin native scrollbar that gains a focus ring when focus-visible.

rows.name: orientation
rows.description: Axis the viewport scrolls along. Defaults to DEFAULT_ORIENTATION.

types.name: Orientation
types.description: Axis ScrollArea.Viewport scrolls along: only the block axis (`"vertical"`), only the inline axis (`"horizontal"`), or both at once (`"both"`).

search-field.name: SearchField
search-field.definition:
A single-line search field: a `<search>` landmark stacking a caption, a
decorated control, and optional supporting or validation copy, composed
from whatever compound parts a given field needs. Its own
SearchField.Input part pairs a leading glyph with the native
`<input type="search">` control it decorates, building on Input for
that control's box, color, and state styling, and
SearchField.Control rows that input with the
SearchField.Clear button that empties it.
search-field.summary: A single-line search field: a `<search>` landmark stacking a caption, a decorated control, and optional supporting or validation copy, composed from whatever compound parts a given field needs.
search-field.description:
Renders a `<search>` landmark — the platform's own role for a search
region, needing no explicit `role` attribute — stacking a caption,
SearchField.Input, and validation copy in a single column.

rows.name: children
rows.description: The field's compound parts: a caption, the control, and any supporting or validation copy.

parts.name: SearchField.Input
parts.description: Renders SearchField's control: a positioning wrapper pairing a muted, decorative SearchIcon with a native `<input type="search">` built on Input, inheriting its box, color, and state styling.

parts.name: SearchField.Control
parts.description: Renders the row holding SearchField.Input and the SearchField.Clear button beside it, and the positioning context that anchors the clear button to the input's trailing edge.

rows.name: children
rows.description: The row's contents: the search input, and the clear button reading it.

parts.name: SearchField.Clear
parts.description: Renders SearchField's clear button: a round, icon-sized ghost Button centred on the input's trailing edge, carrying `clearField()` so it empties the `commandfor` input it names and shows while that input holds text.

rows.name: commandfor
rows.description: The `id` of the input this button empties, naming the control it belongs to.

rows.name: children
rows.description: Glyph or label the button shows. Defaults to a decorative XIcon.

section.name: Section
section.definition:
A grouping wrapper for a set of related items inside a listbox, menu, or
combobox — a native `<section>` element carrying the small block-axis
padding that sets one group apart from the next. Pairing it with a
`Header` as its first child gives the group a visible label.
section.summary: A grouping wrapper for a set of related items inside a listbox, menu, or combobox — a native `<section>` element carrying the small block-axis padding that sets one group apart from the next.
section.description:
Renders its children inside a `<section>` element with small block-axis
padding, separating one group of items from its siblings inside a
listbox, menu, or combobox; pair it with a `Header` to label the group.

select.name: Select
select.definition:
A native `<select>` styled as a bordered, rounded field and progressively
upgraded with customizable-select rendering — a custom trigger button, a
value slot mirroring the current selection, and richly styled options and
groups — wherever the browser resolves `appearance: base-select`. The
trigger, value, and picker styling layer on top of ordinary
`<option>`/`<optgroup>` markup, so every browser renders a working
dropdown from that same markup.
select.summary: A native `<select>` styled as a bordered, rounded field and progressively upgraded with customizable-select rendering — a custom trigger button, a value slot mirroring the current selection, and richly styled options and groups — wherever the browser resolves `appearance: base-select`.
select.description:
Renders a native `<select>` styled as a bordered, rounded field that
progressively upgrades to customizable-select rendering via
`appearance: base-select`, falling back to the platform's own dropdown.

rows.name: color
rows.description: Semantic color role for the focus-visible ring. Defaults to DEFAULT_COLOR.

parts.name: Select.Trigger
parts.description: Renders Select's customizable trigger: a native `<button>` placed as Select's first child, showing Select.Value and a rotating chevron by default, filling the field's box edge to edge.

parts.name: Select.Value
parts.description: Renders a native `<selectedcontent>` element inside Select.Trigger, mirroring the currently selected Select.Option's content via the platform; `children` render as a fallback where it's treated as unknown.

parts.name: Select.Option
parts.description: Renders a native `<option>` styled for the rounded, padded row a supporting browser shows inside Select's `::picker(select)` dropdown, reading its own hover, focus, checked, and disabled states.

parts.name: Select.Group
parts.description: Renders a native `<optgroup>` styled as a padded run of Select.Options, set off from the group before it by a block-start divider on every group after the first.

types.name: Color
types.description: Semantic color role, each mapped to its matching `--ui-*` variables.

selection-indicator.name: SelectionIndicator
selection-indicator.definition:
A small marker that stays invisible, while still reserving its own layout
slot, until the element carrying it is the current selection. Anchors a
menu or listbox option's checkmark, a tab strip's active-tab underline, or
any similar per-item selection cue to a fixed spot so neighboring content
never reflows between the selected and unselected states.
selection-indicator.summary: A small marker that stays invisible, while still reserving its own layout slot, until the element carrying it is the current selection.
selection-indicator.description:
Renders a marker that stays present in the layout at all times but only
becomes visible once its host carries `aria-selected="true"` or a truthy
`aria-current`, so sibling content never reflows on selection change.
examples:
<Tabs.Trigger id="billing" aria-selected={activeTab === "billing"}>
	{t("settings.tabs.billing")}
	<SelectionIndicator
		aria-selected={activeTab === "billing"}
		mix={css({ position: "absolute", insetBlockEnd: "0", insetInline: "0", blockSize: "2px" })}
	/>
</Tabs.Trigger>

sentinel-row.name: SentinelRow
sentinel-row.definition:
A decorative sentinel row shared by every list-shaped compound component
that renders a trailing loading placeholder: a `<div>` styled as centered,
muted small text, sized to match its enclosing list's own row rhythm.
Every trailing-row part across these compound components assigns this
same implementation, keeping the markup, styling, and behavior identical.
sentinel-row.summary: A decorative sentinel row shared by every list-shaped compound component that renders a trailing loading placeholder: a `<div>` styled as centered, muted small text, sized to match its enclosing list's own row rhythm.
sentinel-row.description:
Renders a decorative sentinel row: a `<div>` styled as centered, muted
small text, ready to hold whatever loading indicator or "load more"
trigger a paired enhancement supplies as `children`.

separator.name: Separator
separator.definition:
A thin visual divider marking a boundary between two groups of content —
a menu's sections, a toolbar's clusters, a page's regions. It renders as
a single hairline element whose axis and length come from the semantic
border color and the orientation it carries.
separator.summary: A thin visual divider marking a boundary between two groups of content — a menu's sections, a toolbar's clusters, a page's regions.

shared-element.name: SharedElement
shared-element.definition:
A plain host that carries a stable view-transition identity across
separate page loads, so a same-origin, cross-document navigation morphs it
from its old position, size, and appearance into its new one instead of
replacing it outright. Its identity comes straight from its own `id`,
matched against the same `id` on the corresponding element in the document
being navigated to or from — no script, snapshotting, or scope wrapper
required for this baseline.
shared-element.summary: A plain host that carries a stable view-transition identity across separate page loads, so a same-origin, cross-document navigation morphs it from its old position, size, and appearance into its new one instead of replacing it outright.
shared-element.description:
Renders a plain `<div>` host whose `view-transition-name` comes from its
own `id`, so a same-origin, cross-document navigation matching that `id`
on the other side morphs the element instead of replacing it outright.
examples: // On the listing page

sheet.name: Sheet
sheet.definition:
An edge-docked panel that renders through Dialog — the same native
`<dialog>` host, Invoker Commands, backdrop dimming, and missing-`id` dev
warning — repositioned from a centered panel to a fixed inline-side column
entirely through CSS keyed off a `data-side` attribute. Compound parts
cover a header, title, description, footer, and a dismiss control shaped
for a column-docked panel's own layout rather than a centered dialog's.
sheet.summary: An edge-docked panel that renders through Dialog — the same native `<dialog>` host, Invoker Commands, backdrop dimming, and missing-`id` dev warning — repositioned from a centered panel to a fixed inline-side column entirely through CSS keyed off a `data-side` attribute.
sheet.description:
Renders the panel through Dialog: fixed, pinned to whichever
inline edge `side` names with the far edge released to `auto`, and slid
via `@starting-style`/`allow-discrete` so the close animates too.
examples:
<Button commandfor="cart" command="show-modal">{t("cart.open")}</Button>
<Sheet id="cart" side="right" aria-labelledby="cart-title">
	<Sheet.Header>
		<Sheet.Title id="cart-title">{t("cart.title")}</Sheet.Title>
		<Sheet.Description>{t("cart.description")}</Sheet.Description>
	</Sheet.Header>
	<Sheet.Footer>
		<Button commandfor="cart" command="close">{t("actions.checkout")}</Button>
	</Sheet.Footer>
	<Sheet.Close commandfor="cart" aria-label={t("actions.close")} />
</Sheet>

rows.name: side
rows.description: Physical side of the viewport to dock to. Defaults to DEFAULT_SIDE.

parts.name: Sheet.Header
parts.description: Renders Sheet.HeaderProps.children as the panel's header slot: a tightly-stacked column of Sheet.Title and Sheet.Description, start-aligned at every width rather than centering like Dialog.Header.

parts.name: Sheet.Description
parts.description:
Renders Sheet.DescriptionProps.children as the panel's supporting copy, in a native `

` set to the panel's own foreground color rather than Dialog.Description's more muted one.

parts.name: Sheet.Footer
parts.description: Renders Sheet.FooterProps.children as the panel's action row: a single end-aligned row pinned to the block-end edge at every width, unlike Dialog.Footer's column that only becomes a row as its container grows.

types.name: Side
types.description: Physical side of the viewport the panel docks to and slides in from, fixed rather than reading-direction-relative so it keeps docking to the same edge under any `dir` value, matching the safe-area padding's edge.

sidebar.name: Sidebar
sidebar.definition:
An application shell's primary navigation rail, composed from a layout
root, a collapsible rail, a main-content inset, and a family of
group/menu/item parts for organizing links. Collapsing rides a single
checkbox's native `:checked` state, so the whole shell works with zero
library JavaScript.
sidebar.summary: An application shell's primary navigation rail, composed from a layout root, a collapsible rail, a main-content inset, and a family of group/menu/item parts for organizing links.
sidebar.description:
Renders the rail itself: a native `<aside>` sized and styled through its
`data-variant`, `data-collapsible`, and `data-side` attributes, with
every collapse rule keyed off Sidebar.Provider's `:has()` state.

rows.name: variant
rows.description: Visual treatment. Defaults to DEFAULT_VARIANT.

rows.name: collapsible
rows.description: Collapse behavior. Defaults to DEFAULT_COLLAPSIBLE.

rows.name: side
rows.description: Physical docking edge. Defaults to DEFAULT_SIDE.

parts.name: Sidebar.Provider
parts.description: Renders the shell's layout root: a flex row placing Sidebar beside Sidebar.Inset, hosting every collapse rule keyed purely off Sidebar.Trigger's checkbox reaching `:checked` in this subtree.

rows.name: children
rows.description: Sidebar and Sidebar.Inset, in either order.

parts.name: Sidebar.MobileNav
parts.description: Renders the docked, edge-to-edge mobile substitute for Sidebar: Sidebar's nav content re-composed inside Dialog, docked to `side` and opened via Invoker Commands, not a viewport check.

rows.name: side
rows.description: Physical edge to dock against and slide in from. Defaults to DEFAULT_SIDE.

parts.name: Sidebar.Header
parts.description: Renders the rail's header slot: a `<header>` laying out its children in a centered row, block-sized to a fixed height with a divider border below it and safe-area padding on its block-start edge.

parts.name: Sidebar.Content
parts.description: Renders the rail's own scrollable nav region: ScrollArea.Viewport laid out as a padded, gap-separated column that scrolls independently of Sidebar.Header and Sidebar.Footer once it overflows.

parts.name: Sidebar.Footer
parts.description: Renders the rail's footer slot: a `<footer>` laying out its children in a centered row with a divider border above it and safe-area padding on its block-end edge.

parts.name: Sidebar.Nav
parts.description: Renders a flat navigation list: a `<nav>` stacking its Sidebar.Item children in a column with a small gap, suited to a rail with a simple, ungrouped set of links.

parts.name: Sidebar.Item
parts.description: Renders a single row inside Sidebar.Nav: a native `<a>` colored through `data-color`, tinted once `aria-current` is set, matching Sidebar.MenuLink; its focus ring always reads in that same color.

parts.name: Sidebar.Group
parts.description: Renders a related cluster of Sidebar.Menu items: a `<section>` stacking its children in a column, gaining a divider border and extra space above itself whenever it follows another Sidebar.Group.

parts.name: Sidebar.GroupLabel
parts.description: Renders Sidebar.Group's label: a small, muted, uppercase heading row, visually clipped once the ancestor Sidebar collapses to icon-only, while staying announced to assistive technology.

parts.name: Sidebar.GroupAction
parts.description: Renders a small icon-only action button anchored to Sidebar.GroupLabel's trailing edge.

parts.name: Sidebar.GroupContent
parts.description: Renders Sidebar.Group's body slot: a `<div>` stacking its children — typically a Sidebar.Menu — in a column with a small gap.

parts.name: Sidebar.Menu
parts.description: Renders a list of nav rows: a native `<ul>` stacking Sidebar.MenuItem children in a column with a small gap.

parts.name: Sidebar.MenuItem
parts.description: Renders a single row inside Sidebar.Menu: a relatively positioned `<li>` whose own `:hover`/`:focus-within` state reveals a nested Sidebar.MenuAction that stays invisible at rest.

parts.name: Sidebar.MenuButton
parts.description: Renders a native `<button>` row for an in-page action inside Sidebar.Menu, sized through `data-size` and marked current via `active`; its leading icon is muted, and a trailing label truncates.

rows.name: size
rows.description: Size variant. Defaults to DEFAULT_MENU_BUTTON_SIZE.

rows.name: active
rows.description: Marks the row as the current selection, independent of navigation.

parts.name: Sidebar.MenuLink
parts.description: Renders a native `<a>` row for navigation inside Sidebar.Menu, visually identical to Sidebar.MenuButton.

parts.name: Sidebar.MenuAction
parts.description: Renders a small icon-only action anchored to Sidebar.MenuItem's trailing edge, revealed by `showOnHover` on hover or focus within the row.

rows.name: showOnHover
rows.description: Whether the control stays invisible until its ancestor Sidebar.MenuItem is hovered or focused. Defaults to DEFAULT_SHOW_ON_HOVER; set `false` to keep it always visible.

parts.name: Sidebar.MenuBadge
parts.description: Renders a small count or status pill pinned to the trailing edge of a Sidebar.MenuButton or Sidebar.MenuLink row, hidden once the ancestor Sidebar collapses to its icon-only rail.

parts.name: Sidebar.MenuSkeleton
parts.description: Renders a static loading placeholder shaped like Sidebar.MenuButton: an optional icon-shaped Skeleton block followed by a text-shaped one; compose `pulse()` or `shimmer()` through `mix` for a loading cue.

rows.name: showIcon
rows.description: Whether to render a leading icon-shaped placeholder. Defaults to DEFAULT_SHOW_ICON.

parts.name: Sidebar.MenuSub
parts.description: Renders a nested list of sub-rows beneath a Sidebar.MenuItem: a `<ul>` indented from and bordered against the rail's inline-start edge, hidden once the ancestor Sidebar collapses to its icon-only rail.

parts.name: Sidebar.MenuSubItem
parts.description: Renders a single row inside Sidebar.MenuSub: a plain `<li>`.

parts.name: Sidebar.MenuSubButton
parts.description: Renders a native `<button>` row for an in-page action inside Sidebar.MenuSub, smaller and more muted than Sidebar.MenuButton, marked current through `active`.

rows.name: active
rows.description: Marks the row as the current selection, independent of navigation.

parts.name: Sidebar.MenuSubLink
parts.description: Renders a native `<a>` row for navigation inside Sidebar.MenuSub, visually identical to Sidebar.MenuSubButton.

parts.name: Sidebar.Rail
parts.description: Renders a thin drag-styled affordance along Sidebar's own edge, toggling Sidebar.Trigger's checkbox through a native `<label>` association; marked `aria-hidden` since that checkbox is the accessible control.

rows.name: htmlFor
rows.description: Id of the Sidebar.Trigger checkbox this rail toggles.

parts.name: Sidebar.Trigger
parts.description: Renders the collapse toggle: a native, keyboard-reachable `<input type="checkbox">` wrapped in a button-styled `<label>`; its `:checked` state drives every collapse rule in Sidebar.Provider.

rows.name: "aria-label"
rows.description: Accessible label for the icon-only control — required, since the control carries no visible text for assistive technology to read.

parts.name: Sidebar.Inset
parts.description: Renders the shell's main content region: ScrollArea.Viewport laid out as a growing flex column that resizes as Sidebar collapses or expands, declaring INSET_CONTAINER_NAME for nested sizing.

parts.name: Sidebar.Separator
parts.description: Renders a hairline divider between two stretches of rail content: identical to Separator, with the small block-axis and inline-axis margins Sidebar's own content regions expect around one.

types.name: Variant
types.description: Visual treatment the rail renders with: `"sidebar"` sits flush against its edge, `"floating"` insets itself with a margin, a rounded, shadowed panel, and a blurred backdrop; `"inset"` renders the same panel without blur.

types.name: Collapsible
types.description: How the rail collapses: `"none"` always renders at full width, `"icon"` narrows to an icon-only rail, and `"offcanvas"` narrows to nothing.

types.name: Side
types.description: Physical edge of the shell the rail docks against and, for Sidebar.MobileNav, slides in from.

types.name: Color
types.description: Semantic color role Sidebar.Item renders its current-page treatment in, each mapped to its matching `--ui-*` variables.

types.name: MenuButtonSize
types.description: Size variant controlling Sidebar.MenuButton's and Sidebar.MenuLink's padding, font size, and icon size.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.definition:
A decorative loading placeholder rendered as a single static block,
sized to stand in for the content it precedes and showing a still,
inert silhouette while data loads.
skeleton.summary: A decorative loading placeholder rendered as a single static block, sized to stand in for the content it precedes and showing a still, inert silhouette while data loads.
skeleton.description:
A static loading placeholder: a rounded block filled with the neutral
border color, sized to its container and one text line tall by default.
Compose `pulse()` or `shimmer()` through `mix` for a motion cue.

slider.name: Slider
slider.definition:
A single-value range control built on a native `<input type="range">`,
paired with a track that draws its own background rail and a live fill
bar, plus an `<output>` for reporting the current value. The root shares
the resolved range and value with every part through component context,
so a track's fill bar and a thumb's native attributes always agree
without a consumer repeating the same numbers twice.
slider.summary: A single-value range control built on a native `<input type="range">`, paired with a track that draws its own background rail and a live fill bar, plus an `<output>` for reporting the current value.
slider.description:
Renders the root host: a `<div>` stacking its children, growing to fill
the inline axis by default or a fixed block axis when vertical. Resolves
the range, value, orientation, and thumb id into context for nested parts.
examples:
<Slider orientation="vertical" min={0} max={10} defaultValue={6}>
	<Slider.Track>
		<Slider.Thumb aria-label={t("equalizer.band", { hz: 250 })} />
	</Slider.Track>
</Slider>

rows.name: orientation
rows.description: Layout axis. Defaults to DEFAULT_ORIENTATION.

rows.name: min
rows.description: Lower bound of the range. Defaults to DEFAULT_MIN.

rows.name: max
rows.description: Upper bound of the range. Defaults to DEFAULT_MAX.

rows.name: value
rows.description: Current value, for a slider whose value the consumer tracks itself.

rows.name: defaultValue
rows.description: Starting value, for a slider that never tracks its own value.

parts.name: Slider.Track
parts.description: Renders the visual track: a `position: relative` `<div>` that draws a rail and fill bar as pseudo-elements sized from context's resolved value, and overlays a nested Slider.Thumb so native drag spans its full length.

parts.name: Slider.Thumb
parts.description: Renders the interactive thumb: a native `<input type="range">` reset to cover Slider.Track's full box so native drag and keyboard control span its whole length, rotating with `writing-mode` when vertical.

parts.name: Slider.Output
parts.description: Renders a live readout: a native `<output>` associated by default with the nearest ancestor Slider's thumb via `htmlFor`, so assistive technology knows which control it reports on.

types.name: Orientation
types.description: Axis the track's fill bar and thumb travel along: a full-width row, or a full-height column.

spinner.name: Spinner
spinner.definition:
A busy indicator rendered as a rotating icon inside a `role="progressbar"`
host, colored by a semantic color role and sized by a size variant. Its own
styling holds still — compose the `spin()` factory from the animation
layer through `mix` for the rotating loop, so a page can render the
indicator's shape before any motion-driving CSS lands.
spinner.summary: A busy indicator rendered as a rotating icon inside a `role="progressbar"` host, colored by a semantic color role and sized by a size variant.
spinner.description:
Renders a busy indicator: a `role="progressbar"` host with no
`aria-valuenow`, so assistive technology reads it as indeterminate. Pair
it with the `spin()` mixin from the animation layer for the rotating loop.

rows.name: color
rows.description: Semantic color role. Defaults to DEFAULT_COLOR.

rows.name: size
rows.description: Size variant. Defaults to DEFAULT_SIZE.

rows.name: "aria-label"
rows.description: Accessible label announced by assistive technology for as long as the spinner is on screen. Required — the component ships no built-in copy, so a consumer's own localized string drives it.

types.name: Color
types.description: Semantic color role, each mapped to its matching `--ui-*-fg` variable.

types.name: Size
types.description: Size variant controlling the rotating icon's rendered dimensions.

switch.name: Switch
switch.definition:
A native checkbox styled and wired as an on/off switch: a pill-shaped
track whose thumb slides from the inline-start edge to the inline-end
edge when checked, tinting with the semantic primary color along the way.
switch.summary: A native checkbox styled and wired as an on/off switch: a pill-shaped track whose thumb slides from the inline-start edge to the inline-end edge when checked, tinting with the semantic primary color along the way.
switch.description:
Renders a single `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">`. It carries no
`aria-checked` because an authored value would go stale the instant the
switch is flipped; the live control's own checkedness is what persists.

rows.name: children
rows.description: Visible label text rendered after the track, inside the same native `<label>` wrapping both, so clicking either half toggles the switch with no separate `htmlFor`/`id` pairing required.

table.name: Table
table.definition:
A tabular data display built on the native `<table>` element, with column
headers that become sort links and a trailing row that becomes a
"load more" link — both driven entirely by URLs a consumer computes, so the
sorted or paginated result renders back from the server with no client
state to track.
table.summary: A tabular data display built on the native `<table>` element, with column headers that become sort links and a trailing row that becomes a "load more" link — both driven entirely by URLs a consumer computes, so the sorted or paginated result renders back from the server with no client state to track.
table.description:
Renders the table's `<table>` host: a full-width, border-collapsed grid
with a small base font size, ready to hold Table.Header and
Table.Body. Dev mode warns when it lacks an accessible name.

parts.name: Table.Container
parts.description: Renders an optional wrapper around Table: a relatively positioned `<div>` that scrolls its own inline axis when the table grows wider than the available space, and declares the `ui-table` named container.

parts.name: Table.Header
parts.description: Renders the table's `<thead>` host: a plain wrapper for the header Table.Row, separated from Table.Body by a block-end border.

parts.name: Table.Body
parts.description: Renders the table's `<tbody>` host: a block-start border rules the space between direct row children, and `content-visibility: auto` lets a long body's off-screen rows skip layout and paint until they scroll into view.

parts.name: Table.Column
parts.description: Renders a column header inside a native `<th scope="col">`, aligned by the `data-align` attribute.

rows.name: align
rows.description: Text alignment for the header and its indicator. Defaults to DEFAULT_ALIGN.

rows.name: href
rows.description: Target URL that re-requests the table sorted by this column. Omit for an unsortable column.

rows.name: sortDirection
rows.description: This column's current sort direction, when it's the active sort key.

rows.name: parts
rows.description: Per-part styling for the sortable header's internal elements.

parts.name: Table.Row
parts.description: Renders a native `<tr>` host: transitions its background smoothly, tints it on hover, and tints it more strongly when it carries `aria-selected="true"`, set directly since selection state is native.

parts.name: Table.Cell
parts.description: Renders a native `<td>` host, padded on every side and colored as the table's emphasized foreground text.

parts.name: Table.LoadMore
parts.description: Renders a trailing row carrying a single link that spans every column, standing in for an auto-loading "next page" trigger since fetching more rows without a full navigation requires script a consumer attaches.

rows.name: href
rows.description: Target URL that renders the next page of results.

rows.name: colSpan
rows.description: Number of columns the surrounding table renders, so the link spans the full row width.

rows.name: children
rows.description: The link's visible label, e.g. "Load more" or "Next page".

rows.name: parts
rows.description: Per-part styling for the row's internal cell and link.

types.name: Align
types.description: Text alignment for a column's header and, by convention, its cells.

types.name: SortDirection
types.description: Current sort direction for a sortable column, matching the values the native `aria-sort` attribute accepts.

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.definition:
A set of tabs whose active view comes from routing rather than tracked
selection state: each tab renders as a native link carrying the `tab`
role, and whichever one points at the page currently being viewed carries
`aria-selected="true"` to read as the active tab. `Tabs.List` lays the
links out along `Tabs`' orientation axis, sharing that axis with every
`Tabs.Tab` through component context, and `Tabs.Panel` holds the content
the current tab's page renders inside `Tabs.Panels`.
tabs.summary: A set of tabs whose active view comes from routing rather than tracked selection state: each tab renders as a native link carrying the `tab` role, and whichever one points at the page currently being viewed carries `aria-selected="true"` to read as the active tab.
tabs.description:
Renders the root host: a plain `<div>` stacking Tabs.List above
Tabs.Panels, switching to a side-by-side row when `orientation`
is `"vertical"` and sharing that axis through component context.

rows.name: orientation
rows.description: Layout axis. Defaults to DEFAULT_ORIENTATION.

parts.name: Tabs.List
parts.description: Renders the tab strip: a `role="tablist"` host laying Tabs.Tab links out in a row, or a column when `orientation` is `"vertical"`, with a sliding accent bar reading `--ui-tab-indicator-*` custom properties.

rows.name: activeIndex
rows.description: Index of the currently active tab, for a route-driven tab bar with no client-side measurement of the active tab's bounds. Given with `tabSize`, Tabs.List computes its own indicator position.

rows.name: tabSize
rows.description: Every Tabs.Tab's fixed size along the enclosing Tabs's layout axis, required alongside `activeIndex` since the indicator's offset depends on how far apart the tabs sit.

parts.name: Tabs.Tab
parts.description: Renders a single tab: a native `<a>` carrying the `tab` role, its own border edge kept transparent to reserve space for the sliding indicator.

parts.name: Tabs.Panels
parts.description: Renders the panel region: a `<div>` growing to fill whatever space is left beside or beneath Tabs.List.

parts.name: Tabs.Panel
parts.description: Renders the current tab's content: a padded `<div>` carrying the `tabpanel` role, focusable by default so a keyboard user can jump straight into it after activating a tab, with a focus-visible ring.

types.name: Orientation
types.description: Axis Tabs.List's links lay out along: a single row with the active indicator running beneath it, or a single column with the indicator running alongside it.

tag-group.name: TagGroup
tag-group.definition:
A labeled set of pill-shaped tags with an optional dismiss control per tag,
composing a grouping host, a wrapped list, and each tag's own pill and
remove button. A tag reads its color and size through the same `data-*`
contract as Badge, and its remove control renders through
Button as a native form submit, so removing a tag is an ordinary
server round-trip through whatever form the group sits inside, driven
entirely by the submitted control's `name`/`value` pair.
tag-group.summary: A labeled set of pill-shaped tags with an optional dismiss control per tag, composing a grouping host, a wrapped list, and each tag's own pill and remove button.
tag-group.description:
Renders the group's `<div>` host, laying its TagGroup.List child
(and any preceding `Label`) out in a column with a small gap. Dev mode
warns when it lacks an accessible name for assistive technology.

parts.name: TagGroup.List
parts.description: Renders the group's `<ul>` list, resetting native list markers and spacing and laying TagGroup.Tag children out as a wrapped row with a small gap between them.

parts.name: TagGroup.Tag
parts.description: Renders a single pill-shaped `<li>`, colored through the `data-color` attribute contract shared with Badge and sized through `data-size`.

rows.name: color
rows.description: Semantic color role. Defaults to DEFAULT_COLOR.

rows.name: size
rows.description: Size variant. Defaults to DEFAULT_SIZE.

parts.name: TagGroup.Remove
parts.description: Renders a dismiss control for the tag it's composed inside: a small, ghost-styled Button with an "X" glyph submitting as `type="submit"`, colored from the ambient TagGroup.Tag's `data-color`.

rows.name: "aria-label"
rows.description: Accessible label for the icon-only control — required, since the button carries no visible text for assistive technology to read.

types.name: Color
types.description: Semantic color role, each mapped to its matching `--ui-*` variables — the same set Badge and Button use.

types.name: Size
types.description: Size variant controlling a tag's padding and font size.

text-field.name: TextField
text-field.definition:
A convenience wrapper composing a labeled, described, and validated field
in one call: a caption through Label, the control through
Input, an optional supporting passage through Description,
and an optional validation message through FieldError. Every id
and `aria-describedby` relationship between the parts is computed from
this instance's own stable identifier, leaving no id bookkeeping to the
consumer.
text-field.summary: A convenience wrapper composing a labeled, described, and validated field in one call: a caption through Label, the control through Input, an optional supporting passage through Description, and an optional validation message through FieldError.
text-field.description:
Composes Label, Input, Description, and
FieldError into one field, computing every id and
`aria-describedby` link from this instance's own stable identifier.

rows.name: color
rows.description: Semantic color role for the control's focus ring. Defaults to `"neutral"` when omitted.

rows.name: label
rows.description: The field's caption, rendered through Label and associated with the control through a native `for`/`id` relationship computed from this instance's own identifier.

rows.name: description
rows.description: Supporting copy rendered through Description beneath the control and referenced by the control's `aria-describedby`. Omit to render no description.

rows.name: errorMessage
rows.description: Validation message rendered through FieldError beneath the control, marking `aria-invalid` unless set explicitly. Falls back to a Form's own `issues` message by `name`; an explicit value wins.

rows.name: autoFocus
rows.description: Native `autofocus`. Defaults to `true` for the first invalid field of an enclosing Form's `issues`, landing keyboard focus on the problem with no client JavaScript; pass explicitly to override.

rows.name: type
rows.description: Native `<input>` `type`. Defaults to DEFAULT_TYPE.

rows.name: name
rows.description: Native `name` submitted with an enclosing form.

rows.name: value
rows.description: Current value, for a control a consumer tracks itself.

rows.name: defaultValue
rows.description: Initial value, for a control left to the platform's own uncontrolled state.

rows.name: placeholder
rows.description: Placeholder copy shown while the control is empty.

rows.name: required
rows.description: Marks the control required for its enclosing form.

rows.name: disabled
rows.description: Marks the control inert and excluded from the tab order.

rows.name: readOnly
rows.description: Marks the control's value fixed, while keeping it focusable and included in form submission.

rows.name: autoComplete
rows.description: Native autofill hint, e.g. `"email"` or `"current-password"`.

rows.name: pattern
rows.description: Native validation pattern the control's value must match.

rows.name: minLength
rows.description: Minimum accepted value length.

rows.name: maxLength
rows.description: Maximum accepted value length.

rows.name: parts
rows.description: Per-part styling for this wrapper's internally composed elements.

types.name: Color
types.description: Semantic color role for the control's keyboard focus ring, each mapped to its matching `--ui-*` variables.

types.name: Type
types.description: Native `<input>` `type` this wrapper renders a single-line, text-like control for.

text.name: Text
text.definition:
A run of small body copy, styled at the library's default text size and
the neutral muted foreground color. It carries no color, variant, or size
contract of its own — a description beneath a heading, a caption beside a
control, or any other passage of supporting copy renders through it at a
single, consistent intensity.
text.summary: A run of small body copy, styled at the library's default text size and the neutral muted foreground color.
text.description:
Renders its children inside a `<span>` sized and colored as a small run of
body copy: the library's default text size paired with the neutral muted
foreground color.

textarea.name: TextArea
textarea.definition:
A multi-line native form field for free text entry, rendered as a bordered,
rounded `<textarea>` that shares Input's border, background, and
focus-ring contract. It starts at a comfortable minimum block size and
grows with its content through `field-sizing: content`, so a reply box or
a comment field never clips what's already been typed.
textarea.summary: A multi-line native form field for free text entry, rendered as a bordered, rounded `<textarea>` that shares Input's border, background, and focus-ring contract.
textarea.description:
Renders a native `<textarea>` host styled as a bordered, rounded field,
colored through the `data-color` attribute contract — the same visual
language as Input, rendering only the field itself.

types.name: Color
types.description: Semantic color role for the focus-visible ring, each mapped to its matching `--ui-*` variables.

time-field.name: TimeField
time-field.definition:
A convenience wrapper composing a labeled, described, and validated time
field in one call: a caption through Label, a native
`<input type="time">` control through Input, an optional
supporting passage through Description, and an optional
validation message through FieldError. Every id and
`aria-describedby` relationship between the parts is computed from this
instance's own stable identifier, leaving no id bookkeeping to the
consumer.
time-field.summary: A convenience wrapper composing a labeled, described, and validated time field in one call: a caption through Label, a native `<input type="time">` control through Input, an optional supporting passage through Description, and an optional validation message through FieldError.
time-field.description:
Composes Label, a native `<input type="time">` control through
Input, Description, and FieldError into one field,
computing every id and `aria-describedby` link from this identifier.

rows.name: color
rows.description: Semantic color role for the control's focus ring. Defaults to `"neutral"` when omitted.

rows.name: label
rows.description: The field's caption, rendered through Label and associated with the control through a native `for`/`id` relationship computed from this instance's own identifier.

rows.name: description
rows.description: Supporting copy rendered through Description beneath the control and referenced by the control's `aria-describedby`. Omit to render no description.

rows.name: errorMessage
rows.description: Validation message rendered through FieldError beneath the control, marking `aria-invalid` unless set explicitly. Falls back to a Form's own `issues` message by `name`; an explicit value wins.

rows.name: autoFocus
rows.description: Native `autofocus`. Defaults to `true` for the first invalid field of an enclosing Form's `issues`, landing keyboard focus on the problem with no client JavaScript; pass explicitly to override.

rows.name: name
rows.description: Native `name` submitted with an enclosing form.

rows.name: value
rows.description: Current value, in the platform's `"HH:mm"` (or `"HH:mm:ss"`) format, for a control a consumer tracks itself.

rows.name: defaultValue
rows.description: Initial value, in that same format, for a control left to the platform's own uncontrolled state.

rows.name: min
rows.description: Earliest accepted time, in the same `"HH:mm"`/`"HH:mm:ss"` format.

rows.name: max
rows.description: Latest accepted time, in the same `"HH:mm"`/`"HH:mm:ss"` format.

rows.name: step
rows.description: Granularity of the accepted value, in seconds — set to `1` to surface a seconds digit alongside hours and minutes.

rows.name: required
rows.description: Marks the control required for its enclosing form.

rows.name: disabled
rows.description: Marks the control inert and excluded from the tab order.

rows.name: readOnly
rows.description: Marks the control's value fixed, while keeping it focusable and included in form submission.

rows.name: autoComplete
rows.description: Native autofill hint, e.g. `"bday"`.

rows.name: parts
rows.description: Per-part styling for this wrapper's internally composed elements.

types.name: Color
types.description: Semantic color role for the control's keyboard focus ring, each mapped to its matching `--ui-*` variables.

toast.name: Toast
toast.definition:
A transient notification panel that floats above page content to report
the outcome of an action, colored by one of five semantic tones and
structured like an inline status panel: an optional leading icon or
loading graphic, a title/description block, and trailing actions.
toast.summary: A transient notification panel that floats above page content to report the outcome of an action, colored by one of five semantic tones and structured like an inline status panel: an optional leading icon or loading graphic, a title/description block, and trailing actions.
toast.description:
Renders a single toast panel, tinted, bordered, and shadowed by
Toast.Props.color, with `role` and `aria-atomic` defaulted
(overridable); pair a `mix`-driven `enterExit()`, since it holds still.

rows.name: color
rows.description: Semantic tone of the toast. Default: `"neutral"`.

rows.name: live
rows.description: `aria-live` politeness for the toast's content. Default: `"polite"`.

rows.name: children
rows.description: The toast's compound parts: Toast.Icon, Toast.Content, Toast.Action, or any other content.

parts.name: Toast.Icon
parts.description: Renders Toast.IconProps.children as the toast's leading icon, hidden from assistive technology since the toast's color and text already carry its meaning; swap in Toast.Loader while pending.

rows.name: children
rows.description: The icon graphic, typically a single SVG icon.

parts.name: Toast.Loader
parts.description: Renders Toast.LoaderProps.children as the toast's loading graphic, laid out identically to Toast.Icon so swapping between them keeps the layout stable; pair a `spin()` `mix` factory for its rotating loop.

rows.name: children
rows.description: The loading graphic shown in place of Toast.Icon while the toast represents pending work.

parts.name: Toast.Content
parts.description: Renders Toast.ContentProps.children as the toast's body block: a column flex container that shrinks to fit alongside a leading icon or trailing action, holding Toast.Title and Toast.Description.

rows.name: children
rows.description: The toast's title, description, or other body content.

parts.name: Toast.Title
parts.description: Renders Toast.TitleProps.children as the toast's heading, in a native `<h3>` sized and weighted as a small, single-line label above the toast's description.

rows.name: children
rows.description: The toast's heading text.

parts.name: Toast.Description
parts.description:
Renders Toast.DescriptionProps.children as the toast's supporting message, in a native `

` set slightly translucent against the toast's foreground color so it reads as secondary to Toast.Title.

rows.name: children
rows.description: The toast's supporting message text.

parts.name: Toast.Action
parts.description: Renders Toast.ActionProps.children as the toast's primary trailing control; `type` defaults to `"button"`, ordered before the consumer's attributes so `command`/`commandfor` still run; use `type="submit"` for a form.

rows.name: children
rows.description: The action's label.

parts.name: Toast.Cancel
parts.description: Renders Toast.CancelProps.children as a neutral-tinted, secondary trailing control; `type` defaults to `"button"`, ordered before the consumer's attributes so `command`/`commandfor` still run.

rows.name: children
rows.description: The cancel control's label.

parts.name: Toast.Close
parts.description: Renders a dismiss control for the ancestor Toast: an icon-only `<button>` removable via a consumer's mixin or the `commandfor`/`command` pair; `type="button"` precedes those attributes so the pairing still runs.

rows.name: "aria-label"
rows.description: Accessible label for the icon-only control — required, since the button carries no visible text for assistive technology to read.

parts.name: Toast.Region
parts.description: Renders the fixed viewport stacking every queued Toast at a corner via Toast.RegionProps.placement; `pointer-events` stays `none` so clicks pass through to content behind, restored per toast.

rows.name: placement
rows.description: Corner of the viewport the stack renders in. Default: `"bottom-end"`.

rows.name: children
rows.description: Every currently queued Toast.

types.name: Color
types.description: Semantic tone driving the host element's border, tint, and foreground color through the `--ui-*` variables for that color.

types.name: Live
types.description: `aria-live` politeness applied to the host element.

types.name: Placement
types.description: Corner of the viewport Toast.Region renders in.

toggle-button.name: ToggleButton
toggle-button.definition:
A native `<button>` that reflects an on/off state through its own
`aria-pressed` attribute instead of a separate boolean prop — muting a
track, toggling bold text, filtering a view. Shares Button's
semantic color role, visual weight variant, and size, and layers a tinted
background on top of the outline and ghost variants once pressed, so a
toggled control reads as active without a fourth variant of its own.
ToggleButtonGroup lays a run of these out along a shared axis.
toggle-button.summary: A native `<button>` that reflects an on/off state through its own `aria-pressed` attribute instead of a separate boolean prop — muting a track, toggling bold text, filtering a view.
toggle-button.description:
Renders a native `<button aria-pressed>` host clicking which submits its
enclosing form by default, flipping the state through a server round-trip
with no script required; pair `pressToggle()` through `mix` in a hydrated island to skip the round-trip.

rows.name: "aria-pressed"
rows.description: The button's pressed state, reflected directly onto the host's own `aria-pressed` attribute.

rows.name: color
rows.description: Semantic color role. Defaults to DEFAULT_COLOR.

rows.name: variant
rows.description: Visual weight. Defaults to DEFAULT_VARIANT.

rows.name: size
rows.description: Size variant. Defaults to DEFAULT_SIZE.

types.name: Color
types.description: Semantic color role, each mapped to its matching `--ui-*` variables.

types.name: Variant
types.description: Visual weight: a solid fill with an on-solid foreground, a transparent fill with a strong colored border, or a fully transparent fill with just a colored label.

types.name: Size
types.description: Size variant controlling the button's padding and font size.

toolbar.name: Toolbar
toolbar.definition:
A bordered, tinted panel that groups a set of interactive controls —
buttons, toggles, menus — along a single axis. The host renders as a
`toolbar` landmark and lays its children out as a row by default,
switching to a column when its orientation flips to vertical.
toolbar.summary: A bordered, tinted panel that groups a set of interactive controls — buttons, toggles, menus — along a single axis.
toolbar.description:
Renders a bordered, tinted panel grouping a set of interactive controls
along one axis. The host carries the `toolbar` role and lays its children
out as a row by default, flipping to a column when `aria-orientation="vertical"`.

types.name: Orientation
types.description: Axis the toolbar's controls lay out along: a single row, or a single column.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.definition:
A small floating label identifying an otherwise unlabeled control or
adding a supplementary hint, riding the same `popover`-attributed host and
CSS anchor positioning contract as Popover. Its reveal is plain
`:hover`/`:focus-visible` state read off the sibling immediately before it
in the DOM — the trigger — so pointing at or tabbing to that trigger
surfaces the hint with no script anywhere in the path.
tooltip.summary: A small floating label identifying an otherwise unlabeled control or adding a supplementary hint, riding the same `popover`-attributed host and CSS anchor positioning contract as Popover.
tooltip.description:
Renders the hint through Popover, fixing `popover` to `"hint"` and
`role` to `"tooltip"`. The host stays present in the DOM, entering on
`:popover-open`, `:focus-visible`, or the trigger's hover, animated via `@starting-style`.
examples: {t("nav.settings")}

rows.name: showArrow
rows.description: Whether to render a pointer-arrow child pointing back at the trigger, filled to match this host's own solid background so the two read as one continuous shape. Defaults to DEFAULT_SHOW_ARROW.

tree.name: Tree
tree.definition:
A hierarchical list of nodes built from nested `<details>` and `<summary>`
elements, so a branch's expand/collapse state, keyboard toggling, and
content hiding all come from the platform rather than tracked state.
Tree.Item nests further Tree.Item nodes directly inside
itself to describe a subtree, Tree.ItemContent renders each node's
always-visible row, and Tree.LoadMoreItem holds a trailing loading
placeholder exactly like a row list's own.
tree.summary: A hierarchical list of nodes built from nested `<details>` and `<summary>` elements, so a branch's expand/collapse state, keyboard toggling, and content hiding all come from the platform rather than tracked state.
tree.description:
Renders the tree's root host: a bordered `<div>` carrying `role="tree"`,
stacking Tree.Item nodes in block flow, with `data-empty`
centering a fallback message; an unlabeled tree logs a dev `console.warn`.
examples:
<Tree aria-label={t("files.title")}>
	<Tree.Item id="src">
		<Tree.ItemContent>
			<Tree.ExpandButton aria-label={t("files.expand")} />
			{t("files.folder", { name: "src" })}
		</Tree.ItemContent>
		<Tree.Item id="src-index">
			<Tree.ItemContent>{t("files.file", { name: "index.ts" })}</Tree.ItemContent>
		</Tree.Item>
	</Tree.Item>
</Tree>

parts.description: Renders Tree.ItemContentProps.children inside a native `<summary>` — the enclosing Tree.Item's always-visible row — indented from its ambient depth, with `aria-selected`/`aria-disabled` styling.

parts.name: Tree.ExpandButton
parts.description: Renders the chevron a node's row shows for a subtree, rotated 90 degrees while the enclosing Tree.Item's `<details>` carries `[open]`.

typeset.name: Typeset
typeset.definition:
A typography layer wrapping already-rendered markdown or HTML content and
supplying every size, weight, spacing, and color decision through three
custom properties: `--ui-typeset-size`, `--ui-typeset-leading`, and
`--ui-typeset-flow`. `data-preset` swaps all three for a different rhythm
context; `data-not-typeset` opts a subtree out of the whole layer.
typeset.summary: A typography layer wrapping already-rendered markdown or HTML content and supplying every size, weight, spacing, and color decision through three custom properties: `--ui-typeset-size`, `--ui-typeset-leading`, and `--ui-typeset-flow`.
typeset.description:
Renders a `<div>` that sizes and colors already-rendered markdown or HTML
content through `--ui-typeset-size`, `--ui-typeset-leading`, and
`--ui-typeset-flow`, computing heading sizes via `calc()` off one shared value.

types.name: Preset
types.description: Rhythm context: `"docs"` is the spacious default, `"chat"` tightens the scale for a conversational bubble's denser turn-taking, and `"reading"` opens both further for a long-form article.
